maddeler.e:
تخايلت (form VI)
# تَخَايَلْتُ (taḵāyaltu) /ta.xaː.jal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَايَلَ (taḵāyala)
# تَخَايَلْتَ (taḵāyalta) /ta.xaː.jal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَايَلَ (taḵāyala)
# تَخَايَلْتِ (taḵāyalti) /ta.xaː.jal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَايَلَ (taḵāyala)
# تَخَايَلَتْ (taḵāyalat) /ta.xaː.ja.lat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
